convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iFractals, iMA) with standard parameters. Simple entry/exit rules based on 1-2-3 swing pattern detection. Fixed lot position sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic.

derived_values.name: 1-2-3 Pattern Bullish
derived_values.formula: Fractal Low1 < Fractal Low2 AND Fractal High between > Low1 and < High before Low2

derived_values.name: 1-2-3 Pattern Bearish
derived_values.formula: Fractal High1 > Fractal High2 AND Fractal Low between < High1 and > Low before High2

params.note: SL placed at point 1 of pattern (fractal extreme)
TP at point 2 extreme or calculated from pattern

other_exits: Stop loss placed at the pattern point 1 extreme (fractal low for longs, fractal high for shorts)
Take profit at pattern point 2 or derived from risk-reward ratio

custom_logic_notes: 1-2-3 pattern detection uses iFractals to identify swing highs and lows. The pattern requires three points: point 1 (initial swing extreme), point 2 (retracement extreme in opposite direction), and point 3 (lower high or higher low confirming the pattern). Entry is a stop order placed at the point 2 level. Stop loss at point 1. Has digit adjustment logic multiplying SL/TP by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: Fractal detection must be reimplemented manually - scan bars for higher highs/lower lows with neighbors. The 1-2-3 pattern recognition is stateful: track last two fractal extremes of each type to identify valid patterns. Stop orders become market orders when price breaks the level. Ensure digit adjustment is applied to pip-based values. The pending order placement at point 2 level needs careful price normalization.
